title: LOCAL-GREEDY Phi-OPS perp GLOBAL INTEGRATION — does picking the locally-weakest element (node or edge) to remove beat random / match the true Phi-optimum?
verdict_note: DERIVED from measured numbers — NOT self-declared. A LOCAL-GREEDY operator (argMIN local connectivity weight over a unified node-removal + edge-prune candidate pool) does NOT systematically beat a random choice on post-operation global big-Phi: greedy-beats-random win-rate = 5/10 = 0.50 (NOT a clear majority > 0.5), and greedy matches the EXHAUSTIVE true Phi-optimal operation in only 3/10 = 0.30. The pre-registered falsifier (greedy systematically beats random, win-rate > 0.5) is NOT met. Local marginal-weight ranking is NOT a reliable guide to the globally Phi-optimal operation — local BIO heuristics perp holistic IIT4 big-Phi.
synthesis_of: H_312 APOPTOSIS x IIT4 (RED): removing lowest-Phi NODE raises survivor mean-Phi only 3/10
H_315 PRUNING x IIT4 (RED): pruning weakest EDGEs preserves Phi worse than random (AUC 0.162 < 0.227)
H_314 SYMBIOGENESIS x merge (RED): model-merge = least-bad blend, no synergy
H_313 PLASTICITY x STDP (GREEN): a DYNAMICAL learning rule works (NOT a Phi-structural claim)
engine_reused: stdlib/consciousness/iit4_complex.hexa (subsystem_tpm + big_phi chain; re-exports iit4_pow2/iit4_bit/iit4_units/iit4_project_state — REUSED, not reinvented)
operator_model: UNIFIED candidate pool per substrate = NODE removals (excise cell i -> subsystem mask FULL\{i}) + EDGE prunes (force-0 a present neighbour input, keep all nodes)
local_weight_definition: GENUINELY LOCAL, NO big-Phi inside the greedy ranking (g73 anti-tautology). EDGE w(pos->i) = (1/2^n) sum_s [nextbit(i|s) != nextbit(i|s xor pos)] (avg output-sensitivity). NODE = total local connectivity = sum of in-edge weights (i reads neighbours) + sum of out-edge weights (neighbours read i).

picks.greedy: argMIN local connectivity weight over the whole pool (the textbook 'shed the locally-weakest element' heuristic); ties -> lowest index
picks.random: fixed-seed deterministic candidate via lcg_next(1009 + 31*rule + 7*n + sys) % m (control)
picks.global: argMAX post-operation global big-Phi over the whole pool (EXHAUSTIVE true Phi-optimal single op); ties -> lowest index

metric_definition: post_phi(cand) = big-Phi after applying the candidate op (subsystem big-Phi for node-removal / full n-cell big-Phi for edge-prune). greedy_beats_random = post_phi(greedy) > post_phi(random); greedy_is_global = greedy candidate index == global candidate index.
falsifier: greedy SYSTEMATICALLY BEATS random — win-rate (greedy_beats_random) > 0.5 on a clear majority of the panel ⇒ H1 FALSIFIED (local heuristics DO transfer). Corroborator: greedy rarely matching the true Phi-optimum supports local perp global.
anti_tautology_note: greedy ranks by a LOCAL weight (connectivity/activity) with NO big-Phi inside it; global ranks by EXHAUSTIVE post-op big-Phi. greedy_is_global is therefore a REAL test that CAN fail (it fails 7/10). An earlier draft scored candidates by their exact global Phi-drop, which made argMIN(drop)==argMAX(post-Phi) an algebraic identity — that was a tautology and was DISCARDED before this measurement (g73).

panel.note: degenerate: pure-XOR rule, base big-Phi=0 at sys=11 (no signal — same as H_312/H_315)
most decisive: local-weakest pick gives post-Phi 4.09, true Phi-optimum is 12.93 (3.2x better) — local weight points to a far-worse op
greedy LOSES to random here: local-weakest edge prune collapses Phi to 1.0 while random/global keep 3.5
all candidates degenerate to same post-Phi at this small substrate

aggregate.note_win_rate: 5/10 = 0.50 is NOT a clear majority > 0.5 — greedy does NOT systematically beat random (and never EXCEEDS the random coin-flip in aggregate)

excluding_degenerate_eca90.note: even excluding the base-Phi=0 degenerate cell, greedy matches the true optimum in only 2/9; win-rate edges to 5/9 but this is driven by random's frequent collapse, not by greedy FINDING the optimum (it finds it 2/9) — local still perp global

finding: H1 SUPPORTED (local-greedy perp global-Phi). A LOCAL-GREEDY operator that removes the locally-weakest element (smallest connectivity/activity weight) over a unified pool of node-removals AND edge-prunes does NOT systematically beat a random choice on post-op global big-Phi (win-rate 5/10 = 0.50, NOT a majority), and matches the EXHAUSTIVE true Phi-optimal operation in only 3/10 = 0.30 (2/9 excluding the degenerate cell). In the big-Phi-rich n=4 substrates (eca110/30/54/22/60) greedy NEVER finds the global optimum (0/5). The most decisive case is eca22: the local-weakest pick yields post-Phi 4.09 while the true optimum yields 12.93 (3.2x better) — and on eca105 greedy actually LOSES to random (collapses Phi to 1.0 vs 3.5). This unifies and confirms the H_312/H_315 meta-pattern: BIO local-optimisation heuristics ('shed the weak node/edge') are blind to holistic IIT 4.0 big-Phi, because big-Phi is a NON-ADDITIVE integration measure — the Phi-impact of removing an element is not predicted by that element's own local connectivity. The matching positive cell H_313 (STDP) is a DYNAMICAL learning rule, not a local structural-removal heuristic, and is exactly the kind of mechanism that does transfer — consistent with the finding that the failure is specific to local greedy structural surgery.
honest_tier: GREEN SUPPORTED-NUMERICAL. Local weight = Boolean-network output-sensitivity (one defensible local connectivity measure; an alternative local proxy could shift individual picks but cannot make argMIN(local-weight) systematically equal argMAX(global-Phi) given big-Phi's non-additivity, which is the structural point). Subsystem big-Phi uses IIT 4.0 background-conditioning (external units pinned to sys_state — documented modeling choice, same as H_312/H_315). Panel = 10 ECA substrates n in {3,4}, fixed sys_state; n<=4 keeps exact big-Phi tractable. The win-rate sits exactly at the 0.5 boundary — this is honestly NOT a strong rejection of 'greedy beats random' but a clean failure to support it; the decisive signal is the match-rate (3/10, and 0/5 on the big-Phi-rich substrates), which directly shows local ranking does not locate the global Phi-optimum. A broader sys_state sweep or alternative local proxy is a future extension but cannot rescue local-greedy to the true optimum on a non-additive measure.
